title: To Sleep in a Sea of Stars
author: Christopher Paolini
summary: Kira Navarez is a xenobiologist on a survey mission when she finds something alien that changes her life. It draws her into a conflict between humans and a far larger threat across the stars.
readIf: you like big, old-fashioned space opera with a first-contact heart and a lot of action.
skipIf: you want a short or understated science-fiction story, as this one is long and crowded.

pairings.reason: Another first-contact story with a lone scientist at its centre, wittier and tighter.
A larger-cast space opera with a mystery that grows into a war.
Another story of a scientist who meets an alien presence and is changed by it, much stranger.
